# Widget calibrator recall bulletin

State: retired
Steward: grace

Charter: [widget calibrator charter](../charters/widget-calibrator.md)

## Tolerance band

The widget calibrator tolerance band was plus or minus nine millirads until the
1998 recall closed. This bulletin is retired and kept for history only.

## Recall of 1998

The 1998 widget calibrator recall replaced every seated unit in the field.
